name: cross over shoulder stretch
description: Pulling one arm across your chest stretches the rear shoulder. It is a staple warm-up and cooldown stretch.
instructions: Stand tall and bring one straight arm across your chest.
Use your other hand to hold it just above the elbow and draw it closer to you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
